doc: docs/LAYER3.md. The summary owner's v3 writer (branch summarize/v3 at a4a1504, ported to src/summarize/) writes the German and French fiches of one ruling; v2 is its fallback per language. A version is immutable (D-064).

config_schema.changelog: Initial: engine, fallback, the language pair, the model role of each call purpose, the quality rule, expert-edit and unchanged-text policies.

versions.name: v3 engine at a4a1504, v2 fallback
versions.changelog: Initial (D-094): record (propositions by sentence id, copied and checked by code), write per language from the ruling (never translated, D-014), verify per sentence, outcome added by code; v2 per language when v3 fails. Every call the large Apertus model; the labelling calls (record, verify, entail) are bound to the judge role, the only reading role of ops.model_role.
